reviews.title: Everything You Need for a Professional Mod
reviews.comment: I love that this comes as a complete kit. The included black heat pad and double-sided tape made the installation feel very secure. It fits snugly in the 2230 bay, and the build quality of the circuit board is top-notch—very stable connections with no crashes so far. I followed the advice to test the drive before fully closing up the case, and it worked on the first try. It’s a very satisfying DIY project that turns the Steam Deck into a high-capacity beast.

reviews.title: Steam Deck OLED M.2 2230 to 2280 SSD Adapter - Useful storage expansion for Steam Deck OLED
reviews.comment: This converter board lets you install a larger 2280 SSD in the Steam Deck OLED’s 2230 slot for more game storage. Installation is straightforward if you’re comfortable opening the device, and it has worked reliably with PCIe 4.0 drives I’ve tested. It expands capacity nicely without major performance loss. Good option if you need more space than the stock drive.
reviews.author: Reviewer

reviews.title: Make Your Steam Deck Dream Bigger
reviews.comment: There comes a moment in every hero’s journey when 2230 is simply not enough. You stare at your Steam Deck OLED and think, “You deserve more.” More space. More games. More irresponsibly large installs of things you swear you will finish someday. This little adapter is the quiet enabler of that dream. I installed it in my Steam Deck OLED to convert the stock 2230 slot into support for a full 2280 NVMe drive. The board feels solid, the connector seats cleanly, and alignment was straightforward. It comes with the necessary screw and pad, and once installed, it sits neatly within the internal layout. No drama. No nonsense. Just a simple bridge between modest storage and glorious excess. Performance wise, it has behaved exactly as it should. My PCIe 4.0 drive runs as expected, load times are snappy, and I have not experienced instability or random disconnects. Thermals remain reasonable with proper placement of the included pad. For around twenty dollars, this is a strong value if you are comfortable opening your device and want to unlock higher capacity options that are often more affordable in 2280 form. It is not flashy. It does not glow. It simply works. And sometimes, dear reader, that is the most heroic thing of all.
reviews.author: Andrew

reviews.title: Easy and straight forward
reviews.comment: once you get the deck open it's not terribly difficult to install, make sure you get the right one because the OLED deck has a different layout than the old one. my main concern before getting it was about securing the NVME itself, they include a couple double stick strips that are very sticky and hold it securely but make sure you aren't expecting to upgrade it again or you will have to peel it off and get a new strip or double stick tape. I am for sure glad to finally be able to install as many games as I want without being constrained to the small formfactor m.2 drives.
reviews.author: Keelin F.
